__EYEBROW__: 3D · Z up · DJI RMUC2026 V1.2.0 · Autodesk translation from IGES · meshed from the split part files
__SUB__: Same pipeline as the V2.0.0 page, applied to the earlier V1.2.0 file, which carries per-face colours.
__ABOUT__: This is the V1.2.0 file, written by Autodesk's translator from an IGES source. Every arena solid has a grey body-level style and every face has its own face-level style on top; face wins, so the arena shows white, beige, red, navy and dark grey exactly as the file's styled items say. The mesh comes from the per-product part files of the V1.2.0 split, arena parts at 4 mm, equipment coarser with small faces dropped, placed by the STEP assembly transforms (V1.2.0 has 253 non-identity placements, unlike V2.0.0). Switch to the height tint to compare with the V2.0.0 page.
